description: For a person without an account: creates their planner (new-showtime alerts and reminders included), a private agent token and a Stripe Checkout link. $4.99/mo after a 7-day free trial; everything included; the human confirms on Stripe; agents never handle cards. Show checkoutUrl to the human. After they confirm, Stripe returns them to a one-time link (24 hours) that saves their planner key in their browser; if they lose it before opening it, reissue_claim makes a new one. Keep agentToken private and poll get_subscription_status until entitled, then use the planner tools. Returns not_found while planner sign-ups are closed. Do not call repeatedly or for an existing owner.
name: start_planner
title: Start a release planner
